description: This file contains unit test cases for the PIMLeftMenuService class in the OrangeHRM system. It tests the functionality related to fetching menu items, caching, and permission checks in the context of the Human Resource Management application.

classes.name: PIMLeftMenuServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the PIMLeftMenuService, including menu retrieval, permission checks, caching, and accessibility within the OrangeHRM PIM module.

methods.name: getAllMenuItems
methods.description: Helper method to generate a mock menu items array with optional tax menu enabled status.

methods.name: testGetMenuItemsAllMenusAccessible
methods.description: Test case to verify that all menu items are accessible when permissions are granted.

methods.name: testGetMenuItemsOnlyDependentsAccessible
methods.description: Test case to verify that only the 'viewDependents' menu item is accessible based on user permissions.

methods.name: testClearCachedMenuOneEmployee
methods.description: Test case to verify cache clearing for a single employee identifier.

methods.name: testClearCachedMenuOneEmployeeNotCached
methods.description: Test case to verify cache behavior when no cache exists for the employee.

methods.name: testClearCachedMenuAll
methods.description: Test case for clearing the entire cached menu for all employees.

methods.name: testIsPimAccessibleTrue
methods.description: Test to confirm that Pim is accessible when permissions are granted.

methods.name: testIsPimAccessibleFalse
methods.description: Test to confirm that Pim is not accessible when permissions are denied.
